description.text: The drying bundles have been brought in off the eaves and hang from the beams instead, so the whole room has to be walked through with a bowed head. Tomas is asleep upright. Elin is reading her mother's notes by the fire and mouthing the hard words.

Every beam has something hanging from it and every surface has something steeping on it. Willow bark in strips, a shelf of stoppered jars in no order anyone else could follow, and a scrubbed table kept clear at one end for people to sit and be looked at. It smells green and slightly bitter, and it is the cleanest floor in the village.

options.text: Step back out to the road
